diagram.chart.actionShape: An action is drawn only as a sequence diagram (shape: {shape} is for a flow)
diagram.chart.notFlow: {card} is a {kind} (pass a flow to chart; other cards go to the Section map with roots)
diagram.chart.shapeOf: shape must be flowchart or sequence (got {shape})
diagram.chart.unused: A diagram of a flow does not take {keys}
diagram.data.fieldString: field is the name of a field (a value path), as a string
diagram.data.unused: A diagram of data does not take {keys} (only field and revisionOnly)
diagram.field.dataOnly: field is only for a diagram of data (instance): one data card, or a section that holds data
diagram.map.unused: A contents map of a container ({kind}) does not take {keys} (only kinds)
diagram.room.boxed: {even}goes over {limit}, so each section is drawn as one box and the lines between sections as counts by kind (to draw the cards, {ways}{last})
diagram.room.fewerTargets: take fewer cards in target, or
diagram.room.lowered: At depth {asked} it goes over {limit}, so it was drawn at depth {depth} (to draw it deeper, {ways}take fewer cards in {roots})
diagram.room.narrowByTags: narrow it with tags or kinds in value, or
diagram.room.readCards: read the cards around target with as: diagram of card_read
diagram.room.readSection: read one section with as: diagram of section_read
diagram.room.readSectionOrCards: read one section with as: diagram of section_read, or the cards around target with as: diagram of card_read
diagram.roots.excluded: These diagram start cards are filtered out by tags: {names}. Remove tags, or give those cards the tag
diagram.roots.missing: These diagram start cards are not there: {names}. Check the names with the query of card_list
diagram.section.missing: There is no section "{name}". The only one is: Main
diagram.shape.flowOnly: shape is only for when target is a single flow
diagram.spec.direction: direction must be one of out / in / both
diagram.spec.kinds: These values cannot be used in kinds: {unknown}. This project has {available}
